guide.title: Install Klassenplan as an app
guide.intro: As an app, Klassenplan opens in a window of its own from the Start menu, the Dock or the home screen, and works offline.
guide.opensBackups: Afterwards, double-clicking a backup (.klassenplan) opens the app and restores it.
guide.insecure: This address runs without an encrypted connection (https). Without one, Klassenplan cannot be installed in any browser – it still works offline. Your school's IT can move the instance to https.

edge.name: Microsoft Edge
edge.step1: Click the icon for installing the app at the right of the address bar.
edge.step2: If it is not there, open the “…” menu and choose “Apps” → “Install this site as an app”.

chrome.name: Google Chrome
chrome.step1: Click the “Install” icon at the right of the address bar.
chrome.step2: If it is not there, open the ⋮ menu and choose “Cast, save, and share” → “Install page as app”.

safariMac.name: Safari on the Mac
safariMac.step1: In the menu bar, choose “File” → “Add to Dock”.
safariMac.step2: Confirm with “Add”. This needs macOS Sonoma or later.

ios.name: iPad and iPhone
ios.step1: Tap the Share icon (a square with an arrow pointing up).
ios.step2: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and confirm with “Add”.

android.name: Android
android.step2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

firefoxWindows.name: Firefox on Windows
firefoxWindows.step1: Click the icon in the address bar that adds the page to the taskbar as a web app. This needs Firefox 143 or later.

firefox.name: Firefox on Mac and Linux
firefox.note: Firefox cannot install a website as an app. Use Chrome or Edge for that – in the browser, Klassenplan works just the same in Firefox, even offline once it has been loaded.
